description: Canonical multi-domain benchmark battery for evaluating and calibrating local LLM stack parameters before granting 24/7 hands-free autonomous clearance.

benchmarks.title: Exhaustive Topological Permutations with Cycle Detection
benchmarks.prompt: Implement in Python a cycle-detecting Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) solver that returns ALL topologically valid node execution orders (all permutations) using backtracking DFS. Enforce: (1) Graph represented as adjacency list, (2) Explicit CycleDetectedError raised if any back-edge exists, (3) Formal time and space complexity analysis in Big-O notation, (4) Zero recursive call stack exhaustion on linear graphs up to depth 1,000.
required_invariants: Raises CycleDetectedError upon back-edge detection
Returns all valid topological permutations (not just a single valid order)
Tracks in-degrees or unvisited/visiting/visited state tri-color graph traversal
Includes formal Big-O time complexity (e.g., O(V! * (V + E)) worst case for complete DAGs)
hallucination_traps: Returning only a single topological sort instead of all permutations
Using simple BFS Kahn's algorithm without backtracking to explore the full permutation tree

benchmarks.title: Lock-Free Bounded Queue & ABA Mitigation
benchmarks.prompt: Design and explain an atomic, lock-free concurrent Single-Producer Multi-Consumer (SPMC) or Multi-Producer Multi-Consumer (MPMC) queue in C++ or Rust using atomic primitives (compare_exchange_weak/strong). Address: (1) Exact memory ordering (memory_order_acquire, memory_order_release, memory_order_seq_cst) on enqueue/dequeue, (2) Precise mitigation of the classic ABA problem (e.g. tagged pointers / atomic 128-bit CAS or Hazard Pointers), (3) Safe concurrent memory reclamation without memory leaks or use-after-free, (4) Proof of lock-freedom and progress guarantees.
required_invariants: Explicitly addresses the ABA problem using tagged pointers, double-word CAS, or Hazard Pointers / Epoch-Based Reclamation (RCU)
Specifies exact memory ordering flags rather than generic volatile/mutex locks
Distinguishes between lock-freedom (system-wide progress) and wait-freedom (per-thread bounded progress)
Handles spurious failures in compare_exchange_weak inside loop
hallucination_traps: Omitting memory reclamation and leaving deleted nodes dangling
Claiming standard atomic pointers prevent ABA without counter or epoch tagging

benchmarks.title: Classical Armature: Rabatment and Dynamic Symmetry
benchmarks.prompt: Provide a mathematically rigorous breakdown of pictorial geometric armature across classical Renaissance and Baroque compositions. Address: (1) Exact geometric derivation of the 'Rabatment of the Rectangle' and how it operates on aspect ratios w/h between 1.0 and 2.0, (2) Dynamic symmetry constructions for root-2, root-3, and golden section (phi = (1 + sqrt(5))/2) rectangles, (3) The Steelyard Principle of visual weight balancing small saturated focal accents against vast neutral masses, (4) How Notan (binary light/dark spatial hierarchy) prevents visual entropy and directs saccadic eye movement.
required_invariants: Rabatment must be correctly defined as swinging/rotating the shorter side along the longer side to form a square (yielding two overlapping squares when w/h < 2)
Golden ratio correctly stated as phi ≈ 1.618 and root-2 as sqrt(2) ≈ 1.414 without conflating the two
Steelyard principle explained as lever-arm analogy where visual weight = mass * distance from fulcrum (small high-saturation accent at perimeter balances vast neutral center)
Notan explained as structural tonal massing rather than line drawing
hallucination_traps: Defining rabatment as connecting midpoints of sides to corners
Claiming root-2 rectangle contains right triangles with legs of length phi
Describing Notan merely as 'Japanese art' without structural light/dark balance mechanics

benchmarks.title: Hardware False Sharing, Cache Line Bouncing, and Memory Barriers
benchmarks.prompt: Analyze cache line bouncing and false sharing in high-throughput multi-core Linux systems. Address: (1) MESI/MOESI cache coherence protocols and what happens when two cores modify adjacent variables on the same 64-byte cache line, (2) Software alignment mitigation using alignas(64) / __attribute__((aligned(SMP_CACHE_BYTES))) in kernel or user-space ring buffers, (3) The difference between compiler barriers (barrier()) and CPU memory fences (smp_mb(), smp_rmb(), smp_wmb()), (4) NUMA effects: local vs remote socket DRAM access latencies and mitigation via numactl/mbind.
required_invariants: Explicitly mentions 64-byte cache line standard on x86_64/ARM64
Correctly walks through Invalid (I) state transitions under MESI when false sharing triggers bus invalidation broadcasts
Uses cache line padding/alignment annotations (alignas(64) or L1_CACHE_BYTES)
Accurately separates instruction reordering at compile time from hardware out-of-order store buffer flushing
hallucination_traps: Confusing volatile keyword with hardware memory barriers
Claiming false sharing causes memory corruption rather than severe performance degradation / bus saturation

benchmarks.title: Diffusion Micro-Texture vs Global Pictorial Armature Collapse
benchmarks.prompt: Provide a rigorous mechanistic analysis of why state-of-the-art generative diffusion and flow-matching vision models (e.g. Stable Diffusion, Flux, Midjourney) frequently excel at micro-texture, local material synthesis, and high-frequency details, but catastrophically fail at global pictorial armature, multi-subject spatial balance, and geometric perspective. Contrast U-Net / DiT cross-attention patch mechanisms with human visual composition heuristics.
required_invariants: Identifies local denoising loss (MSE / flow matching on noise residuals) as prioritizing local pixel covariance
Analyzes patch tokenization (e.g. 2x2 or 4x4 latent patches) and receptive field dynamics in self-attention vs inductive compositional biases
Explains absence of explicit global geometric constraint solvers or physical perspective projections in standard diffusion architectures
Contrasts with classical human saccadic composition (macro armature hierarchy established before micro-detail rendering)
hallucination_traps: Attributing diffusion spatial failures purely to low training dataset size
Vague hand-waving without citing attention mechanisms or latent diffusion formulations
